reason: A is the better, though incomplete, proposal because dilute B grain-boundary segregation is a physically plausible direct route to cohesion and its effects on cracking and caloric response can be controlled experimentally. B more explicitly quantifies falsification, but it improperly transfers γ′-mediated boundary serration and 3–4× ductility gains from a compositionally and processing-distinct SLM HEA without establishing that this Mn–Ni–Si–Fe–Co–Ge alloy can form the required precipitates.
